summary: Iteration 71 - Bank Logo Upload (150x150) and Component Toggles Feature - All backend (9/9) and frontend tests passed. Features implemented: 1) Logo upload area is 150x150px with hover overlay showing Cambiar/Eliminar buttons, 2) Component toggles (VPOS, MPOS, PG, Link) are clickable and change color correctly, 3) Toggle states persist after saving bank, 4) Bank Detail (Visor 360°) correctly filters products by component type.

minor.issue: Code comment says 'Resize to 100x100' but code actually resizes to 150x150 - comment should be updated

issues: Logo shows as broken image alt text when uploads directory is volatile (expected in preview env)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Line 37 in banks.py has outdated comment '# Resize to 100x100 using PIL' but code uses 150x150
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tests use existing Banco de Venezuela (bnk_3997d471d939) and revert changes after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank logo and component toggle features verified. Key points: 1) Logo upload area uses inline style for 150x150px, 2) Hover overlay shows Cambiar/Eliminar buttons only when logo exists, 3) Component toggles use data-testid format: toggle-{vpos|mpos|gw|link}-{index}, 4) Active toggles have colored bg (blue-500, purple-500, green-500, amber-500), inactive have bg-slate-200 with line-through, 5) New product toggles appear after selecting a medio de pago and use data-testid: new-toggle-{vpos_available|mpos_available|gateway_available|link_available}, 6) Bank Detail page at /banks/:bankId shows 3 sections filtering products by component type.
